summary: Iteration 9 — verified the 3 requested changes: (1) Ask AI is now the FIRST sidebar nav item and the default landing page after login; visiting root '/' redirects to /app/ask (both confirmed live). (2) Ask AI is now a ChatGPT-style multi-turn chat tool: user bubble, thinking indicator, assistant reply rendered as Markdown, per-message copy button (Copied toast fires), New chat clears, History dropdown lists past threads, suggestion chips send as message. Backend chat multi-turn context persistence was verified via pytest (thread history stored + resent to Gemini) — the frontend multi-turn assertion hit the shared Gemini free-tier 429 but the app gracefully rendered the sanitised toast + fallback assistant message, which is the intended behaviour. (3) Learn from Scratch cards show a STAGE badge (STAGE 1 for existing courses, would render Master crown at stage>=10), a Trash icon that opens an AlertDialog confirm, and per-card Continue/Redo + Next stage buttons. Delete flow removed the card and persisted across reload. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py (chat empty->400, first msg creates thread_id, multi-turn thread reuse, list threads excludes messages, get thread returns full messages, delete thread + 404 after, auth required, course delete 404, complete idempotent). No new bugs found; the previous iteration-8 infinity-loop concern was NOT re-tested here because it is not part of this review request (Ask AI + Learn cards only) and doing so would have consumed extra Gemini quota that we needed for chat tests.
critical_code_review_comments: AskAI.jsx: fallback italic message '_Sorry — I couldn't respond just now…_' is inserted as an assistant bubble on failure; note this is a UI-only bubble and is NOT persisted server-side (backend never stored a failed reply), which is correct behaviour but means subsequent messages in the same thread will lack that turn — worth flagging in a code comment.

server.py /chat: consume(current, 'ask') runs only after a successful ai_service.chat_reply, so failed AI calls do not burn quota (verified indirectly — the 429 from Gemini in UI test did not increment usage since the toast surfaced the AIError before consume).

Layout.jsx NAV array now has Ask AI first (position 0) and NavLink data-testid pattern is stable ('nav-ask-ai'). Duplicate rendering in desktop <aside> + mobile <Sheet> is expected (playwright must scope to aside when needed) — non-issue.

LearnScratch.jsx passes stage=(c.stage||1)+1 and journey_id when calling POST /ai/course from Next stage — matches backend contract in server.py:186 which honours body.stage / body.journey_id, so the ladder metadata will persist correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows verified live; chat multi-turn text contents not asserted due to Gemini 429, but backend pytest already covers it)

seed_data_creation: Deleted 1 course (course_403648b4dc24 'Casual and Specific French Greetings') as part of the delete-flow test. 2 new chat threads were created on the demo account by the test messages and one of them was deleted; the other remains in History (harmless). No other seed data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gemini free-tier hit 429 mid-run on the very first follow-up chat message today — if you need multi-turn chat with fresh context in the UI, either reset usage (python3 -c "from dotenv import dotenv_values; from pymongo import MongoClient; e=dotenv_values('/app/backend/.env'); MongoClient(e['MONGO_URL'])[e['DB_NAME']]['usage'].update_many({},{'$set':{'course':0,'ask':0,'quiz':0,'document':0,'word':0}})") OR just trust the backend pytest (test_iteration9.py::TestChat::test_chat_multi_turn_context) which does the same check via API. Sidebar has duplicate data-testid because of desktop aside + mobile Sheet — scope selectors to 'aside nav a' when asserting nav order. Stage badge text is CSS-uppercased ('STAGE 1'), so use case-insensitive comparisons in Playwright.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — all 3 requested features work as specified; no bugs surfaced this iteration.
